item.title: Meet GIV Gowns: Why Patient Dignity Starts With What You Wear
item.description: After 15 years in clinical practice, Shawn Gibbs saw patients delay care because of outdated medical gowns. GIV Gowns was created to restore dignity, confidence, and trust inside the exam room.

item.title: The Fight for Power: A New Film Investigating the Surge in Our Energy Bills

item.title: Meet KENT, Building Super Natural Basics Without Plastic
item.description: KENT is redefining underwear with 100 percent natural, plastic free materials. Founder Stacy Grace shares how super natural basics can protect human health, reduce waste, and return clothing to the earth instead of landfills.

item.title: Microplastics: Definition + Examples
item.description: Microplastics are solid plastic particles, typically composed of synthetic polymers, measuring less than 5 millimeters in diameter.
